title: security: rbac-v2 + KMS residency enhancements and audit logging hardening
author: Maya Patel
description: Adds RBAC v2 enforcement hooks for KMS key region/residency constraints, upgrades audit logging to include KMS key context and region pin metadata, and introduces a policy evaluation endpoint for automated residency checks. This PR implements: 1) new rbac/v2 policy predicates for kms:region and kms:residency_policy, 2) gating in the key-creation and key-attach flows to validate region pinning against customer tenancy and data residency rules, 3) audit log schema change to include kms_key_id, kms_region_pin, and residency_evaluation_result, 4) migration tooling to backfill existing key metadata and 5) unit + integration tests and docs. Motivation: customers in regulated industries require enforcement + observable audit trail for keys used with private deployments and Dedicated capacity. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is audit-only unless account policy flips enforcement flag. See Linear ENG-1984 for rollout plan and SUP-881 for customer repros.
